seasons.name: Stagione 1
seasons.plot: Chu Sang U, a strict computer science student, clashes with design major Jang Jae Yeong after removing his name from a project, leading to unexpected sparks.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: SangWoo removes his teammates' names from a group presentation for being freeloaders.  JaeYoung, who then fails the subject, vows revenge.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: JaeYoung sconvolge l'esistenza accuratamente ordinata di SangWoo.

translations.value: JaeYoung sconvolge l'esistenza accuratamente ordinata di SangWoo.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: SangWoo tries to regain control.  JaeYoung prevents a fight between SangWoo and a potential mentor in a bar.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: SangWoo permette a JaeYoung di visitare per dieci minuti. JaeYoung decide di cambiare approccio.  Loro eseguono insieme la loro presentazione in francese.

translations.value: SangWoo permette a JaeYoung di visitare per dieci minuti. JaeYoung decide di cambiare approccio.  Loro eseguono insieme la loro presentazione in francese.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: JaeYoung invites SangWoo to the movies, causing him confusion.  JaeYoung vows to leave SangWoo alone, taking a part-time job to keep busy.  JiHye helps SangWoo debug an error.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: SangWoo attempts to apologise, but JaeYoung is unmoved.  SangWoo tries again, and JaeYoung agrees to work on the project together.  Their respective working styles cause problems.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: SangWoo and JaeYoung play Yaja Time.  JaeYoung and JiHye discuss SangWoo, and YuNa tells SangWoo about JaeYoung's past relationships.  JaeYoung gives SangWoo a demo of the proposed two-week trial.  JaeYoung is accepted into Dex.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: SangWoo refuses the two-week trial.  YuNa accuses JaeYoung of being boring.  JiHye confesses to SangWoo.  SangWoo confesses to JaeYoung.
